dependencies; do not edit it by hand.

## Native components

### Qt 6

- Copyright The Qt Company Ltd and other contributors
- GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0
- https://www.qt.io/

Dynamically linked against the unmodified Qt shared libraries provided by the platform. Omega is conveyed under GPLv3, which LGPLv3 section 3 expressly permits. Full licence text: `licenses/LGPL-3.0.txt`, together with `licenses/GPL-3.0.txt` which it incorporates by reference.

### Go standard library and runtime

- Copyright The Go Authors
- BSD-3-Clause
- https://go.dev/

Statically linked into the c-archive along with the modules below. Listed by hand because the runtime reports no module in `go list`, so nothing in the generated section can find it.

### SQLite

- Copyright D. Richard Hipp and contributors
- Public domain
- https://sqlite.org/

Vendored as `third_party/sqlite3/`. Released into the public domain; no attribution is required, and it is recorded here because a component list with a silent gap in it is harder to audit than one with a line saying why the gap is there.

### anytermqt (pyte, qtpyte)

- Copyright Scott Peterman
- GNU General Public License v3.0
- https://github.com/scottpeterman/anytermqt

The terminal widget and its emulation core. Same author and same licence as Omega. The emulation core takes its name and its behaviour from pyte by Sergei Lebedev (https://github.com/selectel/pyte), which is LGPL-3.0.
